$Comment: The Crafting tree's Sawmill techniques, as gated variants of the jar's Mill. ActionsAnchor Before Mill puts them ahead of Mill in the Sawmill's ordered list, and selection is gate-aware: a press runs the first action whose Requires lets the player in, so a player holding the talent saws with its variant and everyone else gets Mill exactly as before. Each Requires reads ziggfreedcommon:track_pick, the talent's own record (Param is <Track>/<Pick>), never a stat, since a technique is a feature of the talent. The Mill Technique is one choice on the tree, so a player holds at most one of these. Each variant is its own action (Actions/Mmo_Mill_<Name>.json, Parent Mill), and each has its own SawmillProgression child extension for Mill's XP and tables, because an extension aimed at Mill does not reach a variant.
